# ADR <number> — <decision>

Status: proposed / accepted / superseded
Date, owner, reviewers and authority:
Related brief/milestone/PR:

## Context and constraints

Current code, measured problem, compatibility, player impact and constraints.

## Options and evidence

Smallest viable change, alternatives and experiments. Include costs, dependencies,
precision/determinism, performance and migration concerns as relevant. No speculative
benchmark presented as measured fact.

## Decision and consequences

Chosen scope and reason, tradeoffs, affected contracts, rejected alternatives and
revisit trigger. Record the approving authority for a changed shared requirement.

## Adoption

Incremental rollout, parity tests, fallback, migration/rollback and actual status.
A proposed decision does not authorize a rewrite or paid service.
